label: Every actual root gives each NECESSARY_2 being it grounds being at accessible worlds where it exists
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (b2), analyst formulation, unattributed: every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w gives being (GivesTo) to each NECESSARY_2 being x that n grounds at w, at every world accessible from w where n exists. Rigidity of the root's giving to a necessary grounded being, the weakest form argument N1 uses: only at roots, only for necessary grounded beings, only at worlds where the root exists. Classical theism and the emanationist necessary-through-another rival both accept it (the First gives the first intelligence being in every world). It says nothing about contingent grounded beings, so a contingent being sustained elsewhere by another source is no counterexample.
